description:
Rocket is our UK made full power e-MTB. Rides like a Cotic. Reynolds 853 steel, Shimano EP810, 150mm travel.
Riding like a Cotic matters more than it sounds. Most e-bikes, however capable or powerful, feel different from a regular mountain bike in ways that are hard to ignore. Heavier. More planted. Less willing to change direction when you ask. The Rocket doesn't feel like that. It feels like you on a great day, stronger, fresher, and more capable, without surrendering the natural rhythm and responsiveness that makes mountain biking worth doing in the first place.
Why Steel?
A slim T45 down tube, rather than a drainpipe-sized chunk of metal or carbon, means the Rocket retains genuine chassis flex and feedback. That life, that Cotic feel, is what the steel frame preserves, even with a motor in the mix.
The new Shimano EP810 ebike power system is their top of the range, lightest, most powerful motor, intuitive and natural feeling, and highly configurable. The external battery means the down tube stays slim and responsive, with hot swapping and simple charging, and perfect weight distribution for predictable traction and precise turn-in.
100% of the frame is made and sourced in the UK, at Five Land Bikes in Scotland, with the aluminium swingarm and CNC machined parts from hand picked UK makers. Custom A La Carte paint is included as standard, no separate upgrade needed.
Range and Performance
EP810's 650W and up to 100Nm of torque bring as much punch as any rider could want, and the latest adaptive power setting just makes it feel like you on a great day, everywhere, without constantly scrolling power settings. If you opt for integrated Shimano Di2 electric shifting, you have the option of automatic shifting as well, and the Freeshift function that allows you to shift whilst freewheeling, which is incredibly useful.
With the 504Wh battery, 1000-1200m vertical is easily achievable using low to medium power modes. Up that figure to nearer 1400-1500m using the 630Wh.
Using higher power modes and ripping up steep climbs, you are looking at more like 800m on the 504 and 1000m on the 630.
On easier going terrain the batteries really last a long time. Cy did a ride in rolling countryside with a total of 800m of vertical, 83km travelled on the 630Wh battery, and still had 17% battery left at the end. On the other hand, riding at the Golfie in Scotland, in Boost up the fireroad climbs, we emptied the 504Wh battery in 2.5 hours, but that was still over 1000m vertical.
Read the full story of how we developed the Rocket →

Key details

Radical Cotic Longshot geometry, specifically designed for super short 35mm stems, giving incredible steering responsiveness combined with hugely confidence inspiring capability at speed. Proportional C-Sizing brings consistent balance across all sizes.
150mm Rocklink suspension brings traction, fun and interaction via a strong progression rate.
Reynolds 853, Cotic exclusive Ovalform top tube and HD seat tube, combined with motorsport-derived T45 down tube, builds a precise, durable and strong front end with beautiful ride feel.
44mm standard head tube designed with external bottom cup for taper steerer compatibility and angleset compatibility.
Bespoke, Cotic engineered motor yoke saves nearly 1kg.
External battery power system for super quick battery swap, convenient off-bike charging, and multiple battery ride possibilities, leaving the down tube slim for gorgeous steel ride feel.
6082-T6 UK made aluminium swingarm with Syntace X-12 BOOST148 x 12 rear axle and UDH hanger.
Mostly external routing with bespoke 3D printed cable management.
Cotic exclusive Floating Trunnion shock mount maximises shock life and sensitivity.
Enduro MAX and SKF bearings for long life and highest performance.
Adaptable geometry: 150mm fork for trail, 160mm fork for enduro.
Five sizes, C1 to C5.

components.description: Shimano external batteries in 504Wh and 630Wh sizes. The external battery allows quick swaps and off-bike charging, and keeps the down tube slim.
Shimano EP810, Shimano's top of the range ebike system, with 650W and up to 100Nm of torque.
44mm for taper steerer forks: Hope 2H, Cane Creek ZS44 top/EC44 bottom, or Chris King Inset I7
